entities.summary: Adelaide Nathalie Marie Hedwig Philippine d'Affry, Duchess of Castiglione Colonna, also went under the pseudonym Marcello,. She was a painter and sculptor, particularly known for her busts, which she exhibited at the Paris Salon.
